ScatterEstimator, SingleScatterSimulator, set_parameter_file, set_detector_file, set_collimator_file, read_from_file, set_attenuation_correction_factors, label_and_name, name_and_parameters, TestSTIRAcquisitionDataAlgebraFile, set_working_folder_file_overwrite, set_attenuation_image, process, normalise_zero_and_one, get_attenuation_image, PoissonLogLikelihoodWithLinearModelForMeanAndProjData, set_attenuation_type, get_attenuation_type, estimate_randoms, set_output_prefix

```python
import sys
import argparse
import traceback
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

try:
    import sirf.STIR as pet
except ImportError:
    print("SIRF library not found. Please install SIRF and try again.")
    sys.exit(1)

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="PET Scatter Estimation using SIRF")
    parser.add_argument('--raw', required=True, help='Raw PET data file')
    parser.add_argument('--randoms', required=True, help='Randoms data file')
    parser.add_argument('--acf', required=True, help='Attenuation correction factors file')
    parser.add_argument('--norm_path', required=True, help='Path to normalization and attenuation files')
    parser.add_argument('--norm', required=True, help='Normalization file')
    parser.add_argument('--attn_img', required=True, help='Attenuation image file')
    parser.add_argument('--output_prefix', required=True, help='Output prefix for scatter estimates')
    parser.add_argument('--non_interactive', action='store_true', help='Run in non-interactive mode')
    args = parser.parse_args()

    try:
        # Read raw data
        acq_data = pet.AcquisitionData(args.raw)
        # Read randoms
        randoms_data = pet.AcquisitionData(args.randoms)
        # Read attenuation correction factors
        acf_data = pet.AcquisitionData(args.acf)
        # Read normalization file
        norm_file = args.norm
        # Read attenuation image
        attn_image = pet.ImageData(args.attn_img)

        # Set up scatter estimator
        scatter_estimator = pet.ScatterEstimator()
        scatter_estimator.set_input(acq_data)
        scatter_estimator.set_randoms(randoms_data)
        scatter_estimator.set_attenuation_correction_factors(acf_data)
        scatter_estimator.set_normalisation(norm_file)
        scatter_estimator.set_attenuation_image(attn_image)
        scatter_estimator.set_output_prefix(args.output_prefix)
        scatter_estimator.set_working_folder(args.norm_path, overwrite=True)

        # Perform scatter estimation
        scatter_estimator.process()
        scatter_estimate = scatter_estimator.get_output()

        # Save scatter estimate
        scatter_estimate.write(args.output_prefix + "_scatter_estimate.h5")

        if not args.non_interactive:
            # Display scatter estimate
            scatter_estimate.show(title="Scatter Estimate")

            # Plot sinogram profile (sum over axial and tangential bins)
            sino_array = scatter_estimate.as_array()
            profile = np.sum(sino_array, axis=(0, 2))
            plt.figure()
            plt.plot(profile)
            plt.title("Scatter Estimate Sinogram Profile")
            plt.xlabel("View")
            plt.ylabel("Sum of Scatter")
            plt.show()

    except Exception as e:
        print("Error during scatter estimation:")
        print(str(e))
        traceback.print_exc()
        sys.exit(1)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```
